bar.legal.accept: Accept the terms to start using smabar
menu.label: Context menu
plugin.waitingRuntime: Waiting for the Python runtime — see Settings › System
plugin.noContent: The plugin has not rendered this view yet.
settings.appearance.barBorderWidthDescri: Width of the frame drawn around the bar.
settings.appearance.barChromeDescription: Draw an outline and a drop shadow around the bar, or leave the surface completely flat.
settings.appearance.barOpacityDescriptio: Sets the opacity of the bar and its tiles: 100% is opaque, 0% is transparent.
settings.appearance.barRadiusDescription: Rounds the bar's corners. Give the bar an edge margin so the rounding has room to show.
settings.appearance.flyoutOpacityDescrip: Sets flyout opacity independently, so flyouts can stay readable over a transparent bar.
settings.appearance.scaleDescription: Scales everything at once — bar, tiles, flyouts, notifications and this window. Use it to make smabar comfortable on your screen.
settings.appearance.shortcutAlignDescrip: Aligns the pinned shortcuts inside their zone.
settings.appearance.shortcutGapDescripti: Sets the gap between the pinned shortcuts.
settings.appearance.themeDescription: Select the color and surface palette used throughout the bar. A theme can also carry behavior settings — activating it applies them once, and you are free to change anything afterwards.
settings.appearance.tileChromeDescriptio: Use cards behind plugin content or leave tiles bare.
settings.appearance.tileGapDescription: Sets the gap between the plugin tiles.
settings.appearance.whitespaceDescriptio: Sets the breathing room above and below the bar content; the bar shrinks and grows with it.
settings.appearance.pluginAlignDescripti: Aligns the plugin tiles inside their zone.
settings.appearance.pluginAccentDescript: Let plugins show their own accent color instead of the theme's.
settings.behavior.hoverPeekDelayDescript: Sets how long the pointer must remain before the preview opens.
settings.behavior.hoverPeekDescription: Opens a read-only flyout preview after the pointer rests on a plugin.
settings.behavior.accessibilityDescripti: Allow smabar in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility so it can keep other app windows clear of the bar.
settings.behavior.accessibilityFailed: Could not check Accessibility permission. Please try again.
settings.behavior.modeDescription: Reserve space: windows make room for the bar. Float freely: the bar takes no space at all. Auto-hide: the bar hides until you touch the screen edge.
settings.behavior.popupPositionDescripti: Chooses the screen corner where plugin notifications stack up.
settings.behavior.popupsDescription: Acts as Do Not Disturb for proactive plugin notifications; turn it off to suppress them.
settings.behavior.yieldToFullscreenDescr: Lets fullscreen videos and games cover the bar. Flyouts, notifications, menus and settings still open above other windows.
settings.behavior.zOrderDescription: Above keeps the floating bar over ordinary windows. Behind lets windows cover it. Fullscreen priority is controlled separately.
settings.colors.accent2Description: The other end of accent gradients, used on hero surfaces and icon badges.
settings.colors.accentContrastWarning: No single foreground reaches 4.5:1 on both accent colors.
settings.colors.accentDescription: Main highlight color: active tiles, buttons, charts and the calendar's today marker.
settings.colors.surfaceDescription: Background color of the bar, flyouts, menus and this window. Their transparency stays with the controls below.
settings.colors.textContrastWarning: This text color is below the recommended 4.5:1 contrast.
settings.colors.textDescription: Color of all labels; the dimmed variants are derived from it. Left alone, it follows the bar color automatically so text stays readable.
settings.design.resetOverrides: Back to theme colors and fonts
settings.effects.magnifyDescription: Enlarges shortcut tiles as the pointer moves across them.
settings.effects.neighborsDescription: Chooses how many nearby shortcuts join the magnification.
settings.effects.scaleDescription: Sets the maximum size of the shortcut under the pointer.
settings.fonts.listError: The font list could not be loaded.
settings.fonts.loadError: This font could not be installed. The previous font stays active.
settings.fonts.monoDescription: Used for code, values and tabular numbers.
settings.fonts.sansDescription: Used throughout the bar, its surfaces and plugin interfaces.
settings.fonts.unavailable: Not available on this device · fallback active
settings.info.description: A polished, cross-platform home for your shortcuts, plugins and local agents.
settings.legal.declineQuestion: Decline the terms and quit smabar? You can accept them the next time smabar starts.
settings.legal.error: The acceptance could not be saved: {error}
settings.legal.hint: smabar is ready once you accept the license and the terms of use. The privacy notice is for your information only.
settings.legal.hintUpdated: The terms of use changed. Accept the current version to continue.
settings.monitor.description: The preferred display is remembered. If it is disconnected, smabar temporarily uses the system primary monitor.
settings.monitor.fallback: The preferred display is disconnected; the system primary monitor is active temporarily.
settings.monitor.label: Display
settings.location.marginDescription: Insets the bar from the screen edges. Applies to both width modes.
settings.location.maxWidthDescription: Caps a full-width bar; automatic width ignores this limit.
settings.location.positionDescription: Choose which screen edge the bar is attached to.
settings.location.primaryZoneDescription: Chooses which zone gets the main row in the Rows and Solo variants.
settings.location.variantDescription: Arrange shortcuts and plugins in one split row, two rows, or one primary row.
settings.location.widthDescription: Use the full available width or fit the bar to its content.
settings.resize: Resize settings with the arrow keys
settings.shortcuts.iconSizeDescription: Sets the base size of shortcut icons.
settings.shortcuts.labelSizeDescription: Sets shortcut label size when labels are visible.
settings.shortcuts.labelSizeOff: Labels are hidden, so there is no label to size.
settings.shortcuts.labelsDescription: Places shortcut labels beside icons, below them, or hides them.
settings.shortcuts.pinnedDescription: Reorder or remove pinned applications, files, folders, system locations, websites and separators.
settings.shortcuts.resetConfirm: Reset shortcut settings and remove every pinned item?
settings.shortcuts.searchDescription: Find installed applications and pin them to the bar.
settings.shortcuts.searchFailed: Applications could not be loaded. Try again.
settings.shortcuts.separatorDescription: Adds a subtle divider that cannot be launched or magnified.
settings.shortcuts.specialDescription: Pins a native system location to the bar.
settings.shortcuts.websiteDescription: Pins a web address. It opens in your browser and shows the site's favicon.
settings.shortcuts.websiteFailed: Could not pin this web address. Check the address or try again.
settings.store.archived: The repository is archived and no longer receives changes.
settings.store.author: Author
settings.store.blockedListing: The listed version cannot be installed.
settings.store.catalogStale: Catalog last checked {checked}; it may be out of date. Installing fetches it again first.
settings.store.catalogUnavailable: The Community Catalog is not available. Nothing can be installed or updated until it loads.
settings.store.confirmContentChanged: Reinstall {name} {version} from {repo}? The published files changed since you installed it. smabar has not reviewed this code; it runs with your user's permissions.
settings.store.confirmInstall: Install {name} {version} from {repo}? smabar has not reviewed this code; it runs with your user's permissions.
settings.store.confirmModified: Update {name} to {to} from {repo}? Your local changes are replaced; smabar keeps a backup. smabar has not reviewed this code.
settings.store.confirmUninstall: Uninstall {name}? Its data and settings are removed too.
settings.store.confirmUninstallTheme: Delete the theme {name}? This cannot be undone.
settings.store.confirmUpdate: Update {name} from {from} to {to} from {repo}? smabar has not reviewed this code; it runs with your user's permissions.
settings.store.contentChanged: The published files of {version} changed since you installed it. Reinstalling fetches the current files.
settings.store.description: Community Plugins from public GitHub repositories, as the Community Catalog lists them. smabar checks the catalog's signature and each download's content hash — it does not review the code. Nothing installs or updates without your confirmation.
settings.store.empty: The catalog lists nothing of this kind yet.
settings.store.externalWarning: {programs} — smabar never installs these for you. Install them yourself before using this plugin.
settings.store.incompatibleBasePlugin: This id belongs to a Base Plugin that ships with smabar.
settings.store.incompatibleBundledTheme: This name belongs to a theme that ships with smabar.
settings.store.incompatibleMinSmabar: Needs smabar {required} or newer; this is {current}.
settings.store.incompatibleUserPlugin: A plugin of yours already uses this id.
settings.store.installedBlocked: The plugin stays on disk but does not run until a version without the block is installed.
settings.store.installedLocal: This folder has no install receipt, so the store treats it as your own plugin and leaves it alone: no install, no update. Delete it from the Installed list to install the listed version.
settings.store.installedModified: The installed files differ from what the store installed. An update replaces them; smabar keeps a backup.
settings.store.releasesNone: No releases; the default branch head is listed.
settings.store.title: Plugin Store
settings.system.autostartDescription: Registers smabar to start when you sign in. Your operating system can also block startup in its login settings.
settings.system.autostartFailed: Autostart could not be confirmed. Refresh the status, then try the switch again or check your operating system's login settings.
settings.system.autostartUnavailable: Autostart is available in installed release builds. Development builds leave your login settings untouched.
settings.system.languageDescription: Language of the bar and all its panels. Drop more translations into ~/.smabar/locales/ to add one.
settings.system.mcpDescription: Lets AI agents on this machine read and change the bar and build plugins for it. It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so nothing outside this machine can reach it.
settings.system.mcpOff: The MCP server is switched off.
settings.system.mcpPortDescription: The port on 127.0.0.1 the endpoint listens on. A change takes effect the next time smabar starts.
settings.system.renderingDescription: Choose how the Linux bar is drawn. Automatic uses native graphics, prefers a non-NVIDIA GPU when one exists next to the NVIDIA driver, and switches to software only when no GPU is available. Changes take effect after restarting smabar.
settings.system.renderingPinnedActive: This start renders on the non-NVIDIA GPU — the NVIDIA driver would flash stale frames.
settings.system.renderingRestart: Restart smabar to apply this change.
settings.system.runtimeAbsent: Installed on first use by a plugin.
settings.system.runtimeDescription: The managed Python that runs plugins. smabar downloads it once through its bundled uv; you never install Python yourself.
settings.system.runtimeFailed: The Python runtime could not be installed.
settings.system.runtimeFailedNotice: Python runtime installation failed — see Settings › System.
settings.system.runtimeOffline: No connection — the Python download needs the internet once. Plugins retry on their own.
settings.system.runtimeUvMissing: The bundled uv tool is missing — reinstall smabar.
settings.themes.communityDescription: Themes from public GitHub repositories, as the Community Catalog lists them. An installed theme appears under Saved themes and in the theme picker.
settings.themes.deleteConfirm: Delete this theme? This cannot be undone.
settings.themes.exportDescription: Writes the active theme as a self-contained file into the export folder.
settings.themes.exportDirDescription: Export folder — leave empty for the default.
settings.themes.importOverwrite: Overwrite the existing theme with this name?
settings.themes.importPathDescription: Path to a theme file — or drop one onto the settings.
settings.themes.imported: Theme imported — select it to activate
settings.themes.nameBundled: This name belongs to a built-in theme
settings.themes.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, and dashes
settings.themes.saveDescription: Save your current look in smabar and as a shareable JSON file in one step.
settings.themes.saveOverwrite: A theme with this name exists. Overwrite it?
settings.title: Settings
settings.update.description: smabar checks for new releases in the background and shows an update notification. Installation only starts when you choose it.
settings.update.failed: Could not check for updates — no connection, or the update server did not answer.
settings.update.handedOff: Opened in the system installer. Restart smabar once the new version is installed.
settings.update.installDescriptionApp: smabar closes, installs the update and starts the new version; plugins stop until it is running.
settings.update.installDescriptionSystem: The package is downloaded, its signature is checked, then it opens in the system installer. Restart smabar afterwards.
settings.update.installFailed: The update could not be installed — the package was rejected or the download failed. Nothing was changed.
settings.update.savedOnly: Saved to {path}, but the system installer did not open. Install the package manually.
settings.update.title: Updates
settings.plugins.affectsAll: affects all {count} of its plugin tiles
settings.plugins.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? Its code, data and logs will be deleted. Saved settings are kept for reinstallation.
settings.plugins.listDescription: Drag a row or use the arrows to reorder the bar. Hiding takes a plugin off the bar but keeps it running, so it can still send notifications. Switching off stops it entirely — nothing runs, and its data and settings are kept. Deleting removes it with its data for good.
shortcuts.dropFailed: Could not pin one or more dropped items
settings.plugins.storeTeaser: Discover Community Plugins for smabar. Each listing shows its source before anything is installed.
settings.plugins.pluginSettingsDescripti: Source, status and controls for each installed plugin. Open Settings & audio to customise it.
settings.themes.storeTeaser: Discover themes made for smabar. Installed themes appear in your collection.
settings.audio.title: smabar audio
settings.audio.description: Controls smabar playback; your system volume stays unchanged.
settings.audio.failed: Could not load or save audio settings. Try again.
startup.webview2Required: smabar needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen. Install or update the runtime at https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/ and start smabar again.
settings.plugins.sharedSettings: This plugin displays {count} tiles. Settings, audio, deactivation and deletion apply to all of them; visibility is controlled separately.
settings.plugins.startFailed: Could not start this plugin. smabar retries up to five times on its own; if it stays failed, check its log, fix the reported cause, then deactivate and activate it.
settings.plugins.waitingRuntime: Waiting for the Python runtime — its download and any error are shown under System › Python runtime.
settings.plugins.loadFailed: Could not load installed plugins. Reload to try again.
settings.plugins.actionFailed: Could not complete this action. Check the smabar logs for the cause and try again.
settings.audio.pluginDescription: Volume for sounds played by this plugin. The master output in System also applies.
settings.audio.masterMuted: The master output is muted under System → smabar audio.
settings.plugins.missing: This plugin is no longer installed. Open the overview to see installed plugins.
settings.themes.copyFailed: Saved in smabar. The external file could not be saved:
settings.plugins.zipTitle: Install a plugin from a ZIP file
settings.plugins.zipDescription: Import a new plugin or update an installed one. Settings and data are kept.
settings.plugins.zipConfirm: Install {name} {version}? This code has not been reviewed by smabar and runs with your user permissions.
settings.plugins.zipReplace: Replace {name} {previous} with {version}? Settings and data are kept. This unreviewed code runs with your user permissions.
settings.plugins.zipReplaceCommunity: Replace {name} {previous} with {version}? It becomes a local plugin without Store updates. Settings and data are kept. This unreviewed code runs with your user permissions.
settings.plugins.zipDone: Plugin installed. Its current status appears in the overview.
settings.themes.preview.reserve: Windows make room for the bar.
settings.themes.preview.float: The bar floats over other windows.
settings.themes.preview.autohide: Hides until the pointer reaches the screen edge. Hover or focus this preview to see it.
